## Summary

Autodeploy deploys container components but **never** re-renders `/etc/nginx/conf.d/rebar.conf`. The edge is not "skipped because a delta was missed" — its source template is absent from **every** component path manifest in `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh`, so a delta can never be detected. Any merged change to the nginx edge stays permanently un-live until a human applies it by hand, **and — unlike a Gerrit config change — it emits NO signal, so the miss is silent.**

## Evidence (live box i-00880b2c7f13527c5)

The complete manifest set in `/opt/rebar/infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` (BOT_PATHS, SECRETS_PATHS, MCP_PATHS, CONFIG_PATHS, OBS_PATHS, CERTBOT_PATHS) contains no reference to `infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template` — the edge source of truth (the only file in `infra/` containing `proxy_redirect`). There is no `NGINX_PATHS`/`EDGE_PATHS`. The only nginx write autodeploy performs is the MCP blue-green pointer swap against a *separate* materialized include (`mcp-upstream.conf`); it never regenerates `rebar.conf`.

Confirming state: `/etc/nginx/conf.d/rebar.conf` mtime=2026-08-27 22:05:26 (predates the 2026-08-28 23:21 deploy); `proxy_redirect` count = 7 (the pre-`a61d` shape). So change `25fd2cf6dd75` (a61d) is merged but not live, and cannot become live by itself.

Story `gall-plume-adder` (8903) scoped v1 auto-apply to the review-bot container only, with Gerrit config as detect-only (`CONFIG_PATHS`). The nginx edge was enumerated in **neither** category, so it does not even get the `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR` detect-and-signal treatment `CONFIG_PATHS` receives — it fails **silently**.

## DECISION (operator-approved, 2026-08-30): Option A — detect-and-signal only

This ticket is narrowed to closing the SILENT-failure defect, NOT full auto-apply. ADR 0079 (story 8903) deliberately scoped v1 auto-apply to the review-bot container and made Gerrit config DETECT-ONLY, explicitly deferring "config auto-apply" to v2. The nginx edge falls in that same deferred bucket; the genuine defect is that it fell through BOTH categories and gets no signal at all. Option A restores it to parity with `CONFIG_PATHS` without crossing the deferred v1→v2 boundary. Full unattended auto-apply (Option B) is captured as idea epic **sprucing-wise-dikkops (6d60-2d0c-6ff7-444b)**.

## Fix plan (Option A)

1. Add a new detect manifest `EDGE_PATHS='infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template'` in `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh`, declared alongside `CONFIG_PATHS`, with a comment explaining it is DETECT-ONLY (v1 boundary) and why applying the edge (host `nginx -t` + reload) is deferred to v2 / epic 6d60.
2. Add a detect-only block that mirrors the existing `CONFIG_PATHS` block exactly: `if changed "$EDGE_PATHS"; then err <edge-reason> "<operator-actionable detail naming rebar.conf.template>"; log ...; fi`. `err` → `marker AUTODEPLOY_ERROR`, which `observability.sh` (line 232) already counts into the `deploy_errors` metric regardless of `reason`, so no observability change is needed — the miss becomes visible via the same always-on on-box journald→CloudWatch path (no CI-provider dependency; portable).
3. No render / `nginx -t` / `nginx -s reload` / rollback here — deferred to epic 6d60.

Blast radius: one manifest variable + one detect/signal block + tests. Never touches the `gerrit` container; mutates no AWS box (the change deploys itself later via autodeploy; a61d's live validation is a separate operator step).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC1 — `infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template` is enumerated in a new autodeploy detect manifest (`EDGE_PATHS`), so a merged change to it is detected over `deployed..target`.
- [ ] AC2 — On a detected edge delta, autodeploy raises the `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR` detect-and-signal treatment exactly as `CONFIG_PATHS` does (a `marker AUTODEPLOY_ERROR` with an edge-specific `reason` and an operator-actionable `detail` naming `rebar.conf.template`) — never silently ignored. (Collapsed to the "signalled via AUTODEPLOY_ERROR" branch; the "or applied (render→nginx -t→reload)" alternative is dropped and moved to epic 6d60.)
- [ ] AC3 — Detect+signal never restarts or otherwise touches the `gerrit` container and mutates no AWS box; blast radius is the manifest entry + signal path + tests.
- [ ] AC4 — Regression coverage: a script-level test drives `autodeploy.sh` where ONLY `infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template` changed and asserts the `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR` edge signal (mirroring `tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_signals_gerrit_config.py`).

### Moved to epic sprucing-wise-dikkops (6d60) — OUT OF SCOPE here

- [ ] Full auto-apply: render template → `nginx -t` → atomic `nginx -s reload`, with rollback to the prior conf on `nginx -t` failure; `deployed-sha` not advanced on a malformed conf.

### Satisfied by a SEPARATE operator deploy AFTER this lands — NOT by this change

- [ ] Proven live: a merged edge change reaches `/etc/nginx/conf.d/rebar.conf` (mtime advance + new directive set), and `enchanting-phantastic-weevil` (a61d) `25fd2cf6dd75` is verified live at the edge. This is a shared-box mutation requiring operator approval; it is not performed by this change.
